title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Liquid Web /…
description: A stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in Gutenberg Blocks by Kadence Blocks up to version 3.9.1.2. This vulnerability allows improper neutralization of input during web page generation, potentially enabling an attacker to inject malicious scripts. The vulnerability has a medium severity rating with a CVSS score of 6.5.
